search.queryText: _sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/* ("authentication failure" or "FAILED SU") !"passwd" | parse regex "\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s(?<dest_hostname>\S+)\s" nodrop | parse "ruser=* rhost=* user=*" as src_user,src_hostname, dest_user nodrop | parse "Authentication failure for * from *" as dest_user,src_hostname nodrop | parse "FAILED SU (to *) * on" as dest_user,src_user nodrop | count as Attempts by dest_user,dest_hostname | where (Attempts>1) and dest_user!=""
